name: 9730-specdecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B (target) + NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B (draft). Ungated mirrors of the Meta checkpoints: same weights.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 for target and draft alike; the draft inherits the target's degree.
architecture: Target and draft are the same shape: dense LlamaForCausalLM, 8.03B bf16, 32 layers, 32 q / 8 kv heads, head_dim 128, vocab 128256; 16.1 GB of weights each, 32.1 GB for the pair.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, bounded at 512 requests / 1800 s safety.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, fixed shape: exactly 1024 prompt tokens and exactly 128 output tokens, zero variance. request_format plain (no chat template); temperature 1.0, top_p 1.0, top_k -1, repetition_penalty 1.0.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter text assistant with a draft model, serving eight concurrent users fixed-length completions on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: source checkout at 966e31697bdeb47b33b3e26b4aab5999c85f3e90
# (`git describe --tags` = v0.6.3.post1-247-g966e31697bde).

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B
speculative-model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B
num-speculative-tokens: 3
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Everything else is the pinned engine's own default, including the attention backend: no
# VLLM_ATTENTION_BACKEND override, and `speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size` deliberately
# unset so the draft resolves to the target's degree.
